verses.text: Praise the LORD! Sing him a new song. When his faithful people get together, fill the room with his praise.
Israel, celebrate the one who made you. People of Zion, take joy in your King!
Praise his name with dancing! Grab the tambourine and harp and sing to him!
The LORD takes joy in his people. He crowns the humble by saving them.
Let his faithful people celebrate the honor he gives them. Let them sing for joy even on their beds.
Let God's highest praises be on their lips and a double-edged sword in their hands,
to carry out vengeance on the nations and bring punishment on the peoples,
to put their kings in chains and their nobles in iron shackles,
and to carry out the judgment written against them. This honor belongs to all his faithful people. Praise the LORD!
